description: This file defines API routes for managing comments within a collaborative project management platform. It includes endpoints to list and create comments associated with tasks, handles user authentication via JWT tokens, and interacts with a database to fetch and insert comment data.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Data model representing a comment in the system.

classes.name: CommentCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new comment, requiring task_id and content.

methods.name: dict _get_current_user_payload(authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None))
methods.description: Extracts and validates user info from the Bearer token in headers.

methods.name: None _assert_task_in_org(conn, task_id: str, org_id: str)
methods.description: Checks if a task belongs to the current organization context.

methods.name: List[Comment] list_comments( payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), task_id: str = Query(..., description="Task ID to list comments for"), )
methods.description: Endpoint to list comments associated with a specific task within an organization.

methods.name: Comment create_comment( data: CommentCreate = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new comment on a specific task within an organization.

ctags.name: _assert_task_in_org
ctags.pattern: /^async def _assert_task_in_org(conn, task_id: str, org_id: str) -> None:$/

ctags.name: create_comment
ctags.signature: ( data: CommentCreate = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )

ctags.name: list_comments
ctags.signature: ( payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), task_id: str = Query(..., description="Task ID to list comments for"), )
